definitions: A male given name from the Germanic languages.
A surname originating as a patronymic.

blocks.text: White Hall is a small unincorporated community in El Dorado County, California, United States. It is located on the South Fork of the American River, 2.5 miles (4.0 km) east of Riverton, at an elevation of 3383 feet. The ZIP code is 95726. The community is served by area code 530.

Randall is a former town in Helt Township, Vermillion County, in the U.S. state of Indiana. Randall is also 1.6 miles northwest of another extinct town: Toronto, on W County Road 700 S. The nearest extant community is the town of Dana, to the northeast.
